Office Hours

Give teachers a practical way to publish consultation times and let students reserve a place.

Office Hours is a Moodle course activity for private student-teacher appointments. Teachers control when they are available, students choose bookable slots, and reservations are managed within the course instead of a shared spreadsheet or long email thread.

Appointments within the course
  • Weekly or one-off availability.
  • Online, on-site or hybrid meetings.
  • Booking limits, approval and waiting lists.
  • Private calendar events and reminders.
Teacher availability
Set appointment duration, available periods, capacity and advance-booking rules, including time blocked for other commitments.
Student booking experience
Students can see available appointments and, when enabled, cancel, reschedule or join the waiting list for a full slot.
Manage and review meetings
Teachers can confirm bookings, record completed meetings or no-shows, filter reservations and export appointment records.
From consultation requests to scheduled meetings

A teacher offering assignment feedback can publish weekly consultation hours and limit the number of reservations each student may hold. Students select a suitable time without seeing other learners' private booking details.

For meetings that need approval, the teacher reviews incoming reservations before confirming them. After the meeting, the appointment can be marked as completed, and the course can use configured activity-completion rules.

Operational considerations: availability uses explicit time zones, notifications depend on Moodle scheduled tasks, and busy sites should use reliable Moodle locking to protect against simultaneous bookings.
